deviations_from_adr: Keycloak management/health port (9000) exposed via KEYCLOAK_MGMT_PORT env var (added in nit-fix 6ae4c75 per R-1): the ADR specified healthcheck on KEYCLOAK_PORT (8180) but KC 25 start-dev splits http (8180) and management (9000) interfaces. Resolution: introduced KEYCLOAK_MGMT_PORT=9000; ADR updated in the same commit to document the KC 25 port-split. Zero product-contract impact.

JWT preferred_username for agent service accounts: ADR §3 originally stated 'preferred_username = client_id (e.g. agent-orchestrator)'. KC 25 actually emits 'service-account-<clientId>' (e.g. service-account-agent-orchestrator) as the service account user's username. Corrected in nit-fix 6ae4c75 per R-4: both spec (FR-6 table) and ADR JWT contract table now reflect actual KC 25 behavior. T-0060 must expect 'service-account-<clientId>', not bare client_id. This is a clarification of the frozen contract, not a scope change.
friction_events: FE-T0054-0001 (tooling-gap, nit): ci/checks/kc/jwt-claims.sh:50 — check_token() uses global FAIL variable (no 'local'); second call resets FAIL=0 clobbering outer failure. Affects adversarial probe B only (forged token); normal CI pass path unaffected. Product impact: none. Fix: add 'local FAIL=0' inside check_token() at line 50. Not fixed in scope (nit, no product impact).
